units_axes.blender: 1 BU = 1 cm (scale_length 0.01), +X forward, +Z up, rat LEFT = Blender +Y
units_axes.frame_map: Blender (x, y, z) -> Unreal (x, -y, z); rat LEFT (*_l) = Unreal -Y

Carry_Mouth.frame_rule: UE = (x, -y, z); a frame's UE X axis = S*x_b, Z axis = S*z_b (Y = Z x X in UE's left-handed sense); bone-relative values assume the UE jaw rest rotation = S*R_b*S (proved on the Unreal readback: predicted vs read relative)

Carry_Drag.frame_rule: UE = (x, -y, z); a frame's UE X axis = S*x_b, Z axis = S*z_b (Y = Z x X in UE's left-handed sense); bone-relative values assume the UE jaw rest rotation = S*R_b*S (proved on the Unreal readback: predicted vs read relative)

clip_contract.root: root bone never keyed: identity on every sample of every clip
clip_contract.durations: frames N = round_half_up(seconds * 30); N+1 samples on frames 0..N; length N/30 s
clip_contract.loops: frame N == frame 0 in pose; seam second difference <= interior max (anim_report)
clip_contract.additive: EarFlick / TailSettle: full poses that start and end on IdleBreath frame 0; import additive (local space) against IdleBreath frame 0

den.frame: den-local: origin = den root on the floor, +X = out of the den (the opening faces +X), opening 60 x 60

den_eye_plate.uv_rule: U = 0 at den +Y Blender (= UE -Y, the resident's LEFT when it faces out of the den), U = 1 at den -Y; V = 0 at the bottom
